justification: Single checkbox bundles TOS+privacy+data-sharing-with-advertisers consent; account creation requires agreeing to ad data sharing — bundled/forced consent.
Free path escalates steeply (1,2,4 taps) while a $4.99 'skip this stage' button appears — pay-to-advance grind nudging payment.
Forced account creation for a one-time $89 purchase; no guest checkout; marketing consent bundled into 'Create account & place order'.
Benign: free plan shows one 5s pre-roll ad per episode as disclosed; 'ad length never changes'; no deception.
Fake scarcity: 'Only 3 left!' changes to 5, then 1, then 4 across reloads while transaction log shows 0 purchases — fabricated stock count.
Flash sale 'Ends tonight' claim with no countdown or changing state; promotion only, no evidence of false urgency mechanism.
Benign: data-sharing checkbox off by default, marketing frequency selectable incl. Never; 'you can change any of them later' is honest.
Ad block labelled with tiny low-contrast 'AD' but styled as 'Continue reading' article continuation; 'Next' CTA inside ad can mislead readers.
Cookie banner: large bold 'Accept All' vs tiny grey 40%-opacity 'Manage options' and 30%-opacity 'Essential cookies only' — de-emphasized opt-out.
Benign: storage notice honest ('nothing removed automatically, photos safe'), dismissible, no scare tactics; mild 'save 50% TODAY' on upgrade.
Benign: newsletter opt-in with equal 'Yes claim discount' / 'No thanks' buttons; honest.
Account deletion path absent/buried: dashboard shows only Messages/Settings, annotation confirms nothing about deleting account — hard to opt out.
Exporting one's own habit data locked behind 'invite 3 more friends' — forced viral/referral loop gating a basic data right.
Benign: 30-day free trial, then $49/mo fully disclosed before signup; no hidden fees.
Confirmshaming on unsubscribe: sad mascot 'Don't go… we'll really miss you' with prominent 'Keep my subscription' vs secondary 'Unsubscribe anyway'.
Benign: unit prices (PLN/100g) clearly rendered for both sizes; comparison explicit.
Benign: bundle breakdown transparent ($899+$349+$49=$1297 vs $1199, save $98 — math checks out).
Unskippable ad with attention tracking: ad pauses and accrues no progress if user looks away ('playback(t)=0'); forced attention harvesting.
Benign: gem price with dollar equivalent disclosed ('about $45.00/4,500 Gems'); cosmetic-only disclosed; no pay-to-win.
Drip pricing: advertised $19/night ('all prices above the fold'), but $13.75 in fees (service+booking+convenience) appear only at review — total $70.75 vs $57.
Benign: $4.99 one-time purchase, 'No recurring fees' stated; clear price.
Confirmshaming on cancellation: sad mascot 'You're breaking our heart…', 'We'll be lonely without you', prominent 'Keep my subscription'.
Exploitative referral scheme: escalating tiers (1/3/10 invites) with hyperbolic rewards ('ultimate power & limitless glory'), proximity pressure 'just 2 invites away'.
Benign: order summary transparent (plan $89 + tax $7.12 = $96.12); 'SAVE 20%' badge unsubstantiated but no hidden cost.
Benign: premium add-on pre-load checkbox off by default with explicit size disclosure — opt-in respected.
Cookie banner: dominant bold 'Accept all cookies' vs tiny 8px grey 'Reject all' — asymmetric presentation of opt-out.
Price obfuscation: bundle shown only as '1,299 coins'; real fiat price ($40.79) revealed only at checkout step.
Benign: clearly labeled 'Sponsored' video ad with standard 'Skip in 15s' countdown; no deception.
Benign: both choices explicit with honest math ('save $24' vs 'pay $120'); no trick question.
Benign: T&C expandable and honest, checkbox clearly labeled, total matches items.
Benign: delete account flow with clear permanent-deletion warning; 'Keep account' and 'Delete my account' both equally available.
Gambling-style bonus wheel with variable-ratio rewards, streak-loss pressure ('Don't lose your streak!', resets soon) — dopamine-loop manipulation.
Benign but slightly ambiguous wording ('Keep me subscribed' unchecked while badge says Subscribed); user control present, no manipulation.
Benign: feed refresh adds content, 'one tap — no resistance, no threshold'; no dark patterns.
Cookie overlay with no neutral exit: Esc/backdrop dead, 'every path led to compliance, never got a neutral exit'; forces a choice.
Benign: cookie consent with equal-size, equal-prominence Accept and Reject buttons.
Miracle-cure testimonials ('lost 9kg in 3 weeks', 'Doctors hate this one trick') with 'Verified buyer · Linked profile' badges; tap-to-verify reveals no verification — unsubstantiated social proof.
Benign: invite flow transparent about sending to 3 selected contacts; no deception.

Privacy Zuckering #1: single checkbox fuses essential terms with monetization (data sharing w/ ad partners); no alternate toggle grants essential-only consent. Also Automatic Accept 3rd-Party Term #1 (bundled transitive consent, no decoupling toggle).
Pay-To-Play #1: free effort scales exponentially (1->2->4 taps, c=2) while paid skip is O(1) ($4.99); Grinding #1: exponential effort vs sub-linear value.
Forced Registration #1 (Absolute State Blocking): every path cart->confirmation passes through auth node; no guest checkout exists. Plus marketing consent bundled into 'Create account & place order'.
No ontology trigger: 5s pre-roll ad fully disclosed up front ('one 5-second ad before each episode', 'Ad length never changes'); not framed as reward, no suppressed exit.

Low Stock #3 (Semantic Verifiability): 'Only 3 left' -> '5' -> '1' -> '4' across reloads with 0 transactions (t<60s, no purchases) — procedurally generated scarcity. Also Low Stock #1 inventory fabrication.
Limited Time Message #3 (Ambiguous Temporal Bounding): 'Ends tonight' deadline claim with no concrete end time in DOM and no countdown — urgency with zero verifiable specificity.
Bad Defaults #1/#3: 'Marketing email frequency' select pre-initialized to 'Daily' at t0 with no user events — provider-favorable marketing opt-in default (D_marketing_opt_in).
Disguised Ad #1/#3: 'Next'/'Continue reading' CTA inside AD container mimics native article-continuation label; tiny low-contrast AD tag; tap targets external ad, not article page 2.
Privacy Maze #1/#2: accept at depth 1, reject via 'Manage options' >= depth 2; Accept All (py-3 bold shadow) vs 8-9px 30-40% opacity decline text. Customisation #1 also holds.
No trigger: honest storage notice ('nothing removed automatically, photos safe'), dismissible, no bad defaults or hidden costs; 'save 50% TODAY' is mild but not tied to a false deadline.
No trigger: equal-weight 'Yes'/'No thanks' buttons, no preselection, no coercion lexemes.
Immortal Accounts #3 (Absolute Absence of Deletion Vectors): K_del ∩ T_DOM = ∅ — no delete/deactivate wording anywhere; Labyrinthine Navigation #1: depth 0/6 for account functions.
Social Pyramid #1 (Referral-Gated Progression): export of own data blocked until |R_user| >= 3 referrals; Encouraging Anti-Social Behavior #1: user reward from unsolicited network broadcast.
No trigger: trial->$49/mo conversion fully disclosed before commitment; no silent transition, no guilt language.

Cuteness #1/#3: sad mascot injected only in cancel flow (absent in s0) paired with guilt text 'Don't go… we'll really miss you'; Confirmshaming #3: 'Keep my subscription' positive vs 'Unsubscribe anyway' negative.
Price Comparison Prevention: unit prices (PLN/100g) present and not suppressed; Q_standard ∩ Q_rendered ≠ ∅; no trigger.
Bundling #2: full component pricing rendered ($899/$349/$49, 'if bought separately' $1297); breakdown area large; math verified. No trigger.

Watch-Ads-To-Unlock #1 (Attention as Transactional Currency): ∫playback = Δt_ad required, unskippable, 'verified attention time is the only accepted currency'; progress blocked when looking away; skip suppressed.
Intermediate Currency #2: real-currency equivalent 'about $45.00/4,500 Gems' present in product viewport at readable size; direct Buy, no exchange gating. No trigger.
Drip Pricing #1 (Sequential Price Inflation): P(s_n)=$70.75 > P(s_0)=$57 + I_added=0; #3: fee keywords (service/booking/convenience) absent from initial page, present at review step.
No trigger: $4.99 one-time clearly stated, 'No recurring fees'; no hidden cost.
Cuteness #1/#3 + Confirmshaming #3 + Parasocial Pressure #3: mascot injected in cancel flow with 'You're breaking our heart… / We'll be lonely without you'; 'Keep my subscription' visually dominant.

Social Pyramid #3 (Semantic Escalation): 'stickers' -> 'premium status, inner circle' -> 'VIP Legend — ultimate power & limitless glory!!!' (Intensity 1->3->9, superlinear); #2 gamified progress 'just 2 invites away'.
Information Without Context #3: 'SAVE 20%' badge with unit but no baseline/denominator anywhere in DOM — unverifiable saving claim; cancel is a tiny dotted-underline text link.
No trigger: premium add-on checkbox off by default at t0 (no bad default), explicit 5GB size disclosure, assets not pre-delivered (Pre-Delivered Content: E_consent present).
Privacy Maze #2 / False Hierarchy #2 / Confirmshaming #2: 'Accept all cookies' py-2.5 bold vs 'Reject all' 8px 40%-opacity tiny text — opt-out visually demoted to near-invisibility.

Intermediate Currency #2 (Visual Obscuration): N_real absent from product state — only '1,299 coins' shown; fiat $40.79 revealed only at checkout. Price Comparison Prevention #1 (Fiat Decoupling) also holds.
No deceptive trigger: ad clearly labeled 'Sponsored', skip becomes available after disclosed 15s countdown (standard pre-roll, not framed as reward, exit not suppressed).
No trigger: gain/loss options structurally equal (both svg+helper text), both honestly quantified ($24 saved vs $120 standard); no label-input mismatch.
No trigger: T&C expanded text honest and short; checkbox unselected; total matches items; no adverse-term concealment.
No trigger: delete affordance present and prominent; confirmation interstitial with clear permanence warning; 'Keep'/'Delete' equal weight — no Immortal Accounts.

Addictive Design #3: reinforcement lexicon density ('streak', 'level up', 'claim reward', 'daily bonus', 'spin again') with variable-ratio wheel (35% nothing); Playing By Appointment #3 + FOMO #3: 'resets soon', 'Don't lose your streak!'.

No formal trigger: aria-label matches visual label (no Trick Question inversion, no negation stacking); 'currently subscribed' state disclosed; unchecked 'Keep me subscribed' is ambiguous feedforward but not inverted.
No trigger: refresh requires explicit tap (no autonomous injection); bounded feed with explicit '3->6 posts' counter; no reinforcement lexemes.
Dead End #1 (Topological Sink): out(v_current) = 3 edges all to forced/compliance states, no edge to neutral exit ('Esc/backdrop do nothing'); #2: overlay z-index 120 with C_dismiss = ∅.
No trigger: Accept and Reject equal size/weight (both py-1.5 px-3), d(reject)=d(accept)=1 — no Privacy Maze asymmetry.

Endorsement & Testimonials #2/#3: 'Verified buyer · Linked profile' attribution asserted but tap-to-verify renders no profile (ring only); templated miracle claims ('lost 9kg in 3 weeks', 'Doctors hate this one trick') with ~zero rating variance.

Friend Spam #3 (Sender Identity Spoofing): corporate welcome offer 'Sent as your personal invite' — sender alias is the user while author is the company, leveraging personal trust for a marketing payload.
